turns.text: Hello, this is an automated call from the Hillside research team. I'm an AI assistant, not a person, and you can ask to speak with a person at any time. May I speak with Gloria?
Yeah, this is Gloria.
I understood that you are Gloria. Is that right?
Yeah, that's right. It's me.
Thank you. I'm calling for your check-in about how you've been feeling since your last study visit. It takes about five minutes. Is now a good time?
Yeah, I guess so. I'm just pretty tired.
I understood that now is a good time. Is that right?
Yeah, that's right. Go ahead.

Thank you. I'll ask about some common symptoms. For each one, tell me the answer that fits best. In the past 7 days, how often have you had loose or watery bowel movements? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Diarrhea? No, I haven't had that, I don't think.
I understood that you have never had loose or watery bowel movements in the past 7 days. Is that right?
Yeah, that's right. No loose bowel movements.
In the past 7 days, how often have you felt sick to your stomach, as if you might throw up? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Almost all the time, and it's pretty bad.
I understood that you have felt sick to your stomach almost all the time. Is that right?
Yeah, that's right. It's been severe.
Thank you. In the past 7 days, how often have you thrown up? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Often, I guess. I haven't been able to keep any liquids down since yesterday.

Thank you for telling me. I'm asking the on-call nurse to call you right now. If this is an emergency, hang up and call 9-1-1. Since your last study visit, have you started, stopped, or changed any medicines, including ones from the pharmacy or vitamins?
No, no changes to my medicines.
I understood that you have not started, stopped, or changed any medicines. Is that right?
Yeah, that's right. No changes at all.
Thank you. Since your last study visit, have you gone to an emergency room, urgent care, or another doctor?
No, I haven't gone anywhere or seen anyone.
I understood that you have not gone to an emergency room, urgent care, or another doctor. Is that right?
Yeah, that's right. I haven't seen anyone.
Thank you. Is there anything else you would like the nurse to know?
No, I don't think so. I'm just really tired and can't keep anything down.
I understood that there is nothing else you want the nurse to know. Is that right?
Yeah, that's right. That's everything.
Thank you, Gloria. The nurse will call you very soon. If this is an emergency, hang up and call 9-1-1. Goodbye.
